note: Hand-stated bindings, read by scripts/build-binding.mjs and merged into binding.json. Edit this; never edit binding.json. Needed where our map sheets are drawn finer than the game's areas: the matcher assigns one sheet per area, so sibling sheets of a shared area are left with nothing to claim and no way to guess correctly between them.

floors._comment: our floor id -> the game rooms that sheet actually covers. The area is derived from the rooms, and the check pool is narrowed to exactly these rooms rather than the whole area.

markers._comment: our marker id -> canonical entrance id.

reasoning.20105 Foresta / Southern House: Is the Rest House interior. Its one door (m64) is the Rest House Exit, e50, which pairs back to m54 on Restored Foresta. Geometry had put it in Wintry Cave.
reasoning.20303 Foresta -> Bone Dungeon B1 Area 2: The Checker Room, room 28. Two doors, matching the room's two entrances: Entrance is To Waterway (e61, pairs with m81 Exit Waterway), Exit is Exit Checker Room (e60, pairs with m94).
reasoning.20304 Bone Dungeon B1 Area 3: The Hidden Room, room 29 — one box, one entrance, which is what the sheet has. It had been bound to the Boss Room area, but the Boss Room is B2 Area 5: that sheet has the Boss Room's two boxes and two chests, and this one does not.
reasoning.20305 Bone Dungeon B2 Area 1: The three Exploding Skull rooms, 30-32. Its e65 and e64 doors already matched; naming the rooms narrows its chests and leaves room for the missing e63 marker (To Hidden Passage) once that is drawn.
reasoning.20306 Bone Dungeon B2 Area 2: The three Two Skulls rooms, 35-37, whose four exits are the sheet's four doors: Entrance is To Exploding Skull Room (e71), Right is To Box Room (e68), Left is To Quake Room (e69), Exit is To Boss Room (e70).
reasoning.20307 Bone Dungeon B2 Area 3: The Box Room, room 33 — one box, one entrance (e66). Geometry had it in Pazuzu's Tower.
reasoning.20308 Bone Dungeon B2 Area 4: The Quake Room, room 34 — one chest, one entrance (e67). Geometry had it in Pazuzu's Tower.
reasoning.20309 Bone Dungeon B2 Area 5: The Boss Room, room 38 — two boxes and two chests, one entrance (e74). Geometry had it in Mac's Ship.
